title: StackDiff: path-consistency DNS differential harness (v0.1.1)
description: Checksummed smoke and adversarial manifests for Unbound/dnsmasq pair-mode path-consistency measurements, including the August 2026 DNS-02 observation matrix (results tag results-dns02-20260815). Companion software and data for the IEEE TNSM StackDiff manuscript (summary tables only in the paper). Laboratory measurements only — not published vulnerability findings.
